title: Chapter 478
paragraphs: Chapter 478
Episode 133. Times of Choices (5)
"Is it really Lady Mary's ship?"
"Yes. It's been a long time since I saw that ship. I think the name of the ship is... Puberty. Hehe, the ship's name is Puberty."
"It's a strange name."
"It's not a name that Mary herself came up with. It was DeFus, her older brother, who named it."
On Mary's not-so-large sailboat, there was no identification number either. There were no crew members on the deck, like a ghost ship.
'Why did Lady Mary come to see me... Ah, is it that?'
A duel.

Jin and Mary were currently under a contract that stated 'the two shall duel once every three months'. Their last duel was at the end of August last year, when they were subduing Osdok. It was about time for another round.
Hmm, Jin looked troubled as he shook his head.
The duel with Mary was a completely different issue from walking with Yona.
He had to get involved in something bigger than Amella as soon as possible, but if he dueled with Mary, his body would definitely not be in good shape afterward.
"Also, it's rare for Mary's Puberty to sail alone."
"Why?"
"Because she always travels with the subordinates she has conquered, hehe."
Someone appeared on the deck of Puberty.
The distance was too far to confirm the fact that she was wearing a pirate's eyepatch, but it was clearly Mary Runcandel, who was theatrically raising her sword at the bow.
Jiiiiiin, Ruuuuun, Kaaaaaan, Deeeeel!
Then, with a shockingly and destructively loud voice, Mary called her younger brother's name.
The shockwave caused by her tremendous energy shook the entire coastal area. It was only natural for the residents of Tikan to open their windows and look at Mary, wondering what the noise was.
Jin couldn't help but hold his forehead at the sight.
"Hehe, Mary has a great voice, right?"
"It's not just a good level, isn't it? Anyway, it's fortunate that Lady Mary seems to be alone now... Oh, what's that again?"
Swaaaaash-!
Above the empty sea where only Puberty was floating, a foamy white whirlpool began to form as if something was about to emerge.
The next moment, what appeared above the foam was a fleet of over fifty ships at a glance.
'What is this, a submarine? It didn't look like that at all?'

The ships that emerged from the surface were too large and massive to be submarines. The already shabby Puberty looked even more insignificant in comparison. The flashy appearance of the ships made the bland Puberty stand out even more.
It was impossible to know how such a fleet had emerged from the depths of the ocean, but the important thing was that Mary had come to visit right now.
"Kahaha! Rise, the fleet of Mary Runcandel! Unfurl the sails-!"
As Mary shouted, the ships began to spread their sails like wings on either side of Puberty. The fully unfurled sails all had Mary's face drawn on them.
"Fire the salute!"
Boom, pop! Boom! At Mary's command, the entire fleet fired salutes toward the sky.
Despite the bright sun shining down, the nearby sea was colored in various shades due to the noisy explosions of the salutes.
"Wow!"
"That's awesome, Mary Runcandel!"
"What a spectacle!"
"Everyone, come out and see this!"
At first, the residents of Tikan were somewhat frightened by Mary's tremendous voice, but now they couldn't help but be enthusiastic about the sudden fleet show.
Tikan had a tower-like structure. Before they knew it, the residents had all come out to wave, whistle, and watch Mary's fleet.
But Jin's headache was getting worse.
So, he decided to ignore Mary.
"Um, let's continue our walk."
"Yeah, we have to finish before Mary arrives."
"Mary is an uninvited guest, and you are my personally invited guest. So Mary should wait, why are you worrying about that?"
"Well, I think Mary won't like me much? She might even hate me. Hehe..."
Yona had never formed a relationship with any siblings, except Jin.
At the age of eight, after committing her first murder, Yona was always alone in both the Storm Fortress and the Garden of Swords.
She didn't even get to work as a trainee before being sent to Samil, and hadn't even had a proper meal with the other siblings.
That was Chiron's intention.
Although the hierarchy war was important, they had to prevent all the children who grew up with Yona from dying in vain.
Young Yona was, of course, more vulnerable to chaos than she is now.
At that time, Yona could have killed all her siblings at any time. Even then, Yona was already one of the world's top killers and an uncontrollable sword.
Yet, the reason Yona knew about Mary's ship during her puberty or the story of Diphus giving the ship the name "Puberty" was none other than this.
Yona had observed her siblings whenever she had the chance.

The other siblings didn't know about this. They didn't know that Yona was curious about them and sometimes impulsively tried to kill them a few times. Just like Jin didn't know who the protagonist of Green Rose was.
It was because of Yona's ability. Even when Yona approached with her mind, Chiron was the only person in the world who could sense her presence and determine her location in any situation.
'I've been so close to Yona that I didn't realize it for a moment. If you think about it, neither Mary nor Diphus would know that Yona knows the name and origin of Puberty.'
Something bitter seemed to be swirling in Yona's heart, filled with regret.
"In my opinion, rather than hating you, I think Mary would like you."
It wasn't just a comforting word. Jin had often thought that Mary and Yona, two rather unique sisters, would get along well.
"Hehe, really?"
"Yes."
"I'm happy to hear Jin say that. But, Mary has never visited me even once."
- You never cease to amaze me in many ways.
- Please understand that it's because I love my little sister so much. You have no idea how surprised I was when you came to Samil. Even kind Luna never visited.
- That's sad. Does Sister Luna dislike Sister Yona?
- I don't think she likes me. I've broken our promises several times. No, quite a lot, actually...
The conversation Yona and I had in the past at Samil came to mind.
Except for Anne in my past life and Jin in my current life, no one ever visited Samil.
The most significant reason was Chiron's strict order not to interfere with Yona, but that wasn't the only one.
There was no bond or relationship to be formed with someone they had never shared a meal with at the same table.
Moreover, Yona was an extremely dangerous person. There was no reason for the siblings to risk being killed by visiting Yona.
"Heh, I'm fine anyway! Don't make that face."
Try meeting her once; Sister Mary will like it too.
I swallowed those words. It didn't seem likely, but if Mary showed any sign of discomfort, Yona would be hurt again.
A better idea came to mind. A way for the two to form a safer relationship in the future.
"… I understand."
Yona glanced at Mary's fleet.
The fleet was now rapidly approaching Tikan.
"Uh, she's getting closer too fast. I guess I have to get to the point! Listen carefully, little one."
Jin nodded his head. The 'point' she was talking about was about chaos.
"First of all, Amela will never betray you now. To be precise, she can't. I've completely subdued her chaos, so you can feel free to use her."
Yona spoke very quickly. She was getting more and more uncomfortable as Mary got closer.
"Hahaha, little one, you! Hurry up and come out to greet your sister. It's a challenge, a duel!"
Unaware of Yona's feelings, Mary continued to shout. Yona was now fidgeting with her fingers and toes.

"And! Amela's speech and behavior will become childlike. Although she's similar in age to the Black King, she's actually more like a child. She was born with an innate nature like me, and only her uncorrupted self has aged."
Yona grabbed Jin's arm and stepped back. Mary was almost at Tikan.
"There you are, little one! Jin Runcandel, my proud sister! This kid, not even answering. Speed up! I need to see my sister up close!"
"Hahahaha! Did you hear the captain's orders? Row faster, you fools!"
The responding pirate's voice sounded very familiar.
'... Pirate King Cosmos? Did he join Sister Mary?'
As the unexpected situation became more chaotic, Yona seemed ready to run away at any moment.
"Sister Yona, are you really going like this?"
"Heh, heh-heh. If you have any other questions, ask quickly, Jin!"
It seemed impossible to hold Yona back.
"What is chaos, Sister?"
"I can't tell you that! Something else!?"
"How can I ask questions when you're getting farther and farther away while talking! Anything else? Ah, just meet again in Samil later and explain it while playing then!"
By then, Yona had moved far away.
"Alright! Hehe, I'm going now!?"
"Wait, the green roses! Do you have any green roses?"
"Yes!"
"Leave them behind!"
"There are already a few in your pocket!"
When he checked his pocket, there were indeed five green roses tied in pairs. All this time, Jin had been completely unaware that Yona had put green roses in his pocket while standing close to him.
When he looked up again, he saw Yona's retreating figure climbing over the mansion's wall. He couldn't help but smile at her final wink.
'Really, Yona is truly amazing.'
As soon as Yona left, Mary's fleet arrived at Tikan.
Mary didn't even dock at the harbor, she just brought the fleet right to where Jin was. Ignoring all the procedures for entering the city, she leaped straight from the ship to meet Jin.
"Little brother!"
"Sister Mary!"
"You're finally answering! Wait a moment, I'm coming up now! Are you ready to face this sister……"
"Warning, do not jump over here!"
"What!?"
"Have you forgotten Father's command? Without my permission, no Runcandel can step on Tikan's land!"
"…You don't mean to break our agreement, do you? We agreed to fight once every three months!"
Although Tikan was very close, the two had no choice but to shout their conversation since Jin was on the top floor. Naturally, all the onlookers could hear this conversation.
"It wasn't unconditional! Check the contract, anyway, it can't be today! I'll contact you soon, and we'll fight then!"
Mary frowned, clearly disappointed, but she had also anticipated this kind of situation when she came.
Soon, Mary grinned.
"Alright!? I got it, I'll leave then!"
Mary leaving so obediently actually made Jin uneasy.
"Even if we can't duel, at least have some tea before you go!"
"It's okay, you must be busy, take care of your work!"
"Well, in that case, I understand! Take care!"
"Alright! Oh, by the way. It's a shame! If you had beaten me this time, I was going to introduce you to a big opportunity!"
At those words, Jin couldn't help but feel like he had been hit in the back of the head with a hammer.
'It's about a more important issue than Amela's warning...!'
Mary had originally come with an offer Jin couldn't refuse.
